notes.title: HD Mode + Update 4.0 Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hey Breakers!

We have one more final update for Circuit Breakers coming soon as a parting gift and a thank you for playing with us all these years. Update 4.0's headline feature is a new "HD" mode where we've modernized the way Circuit Breakers renders graphics to the screen. For many I hope this is a welcome addition, it helps distinguish the environment from the players and the robots and looks pretty good if we do say so ourselves. Of course, if the new style isn't your thing we've left the old style completely intact and you can easily switch between the two in the menu.

A long requested PC exclusive feature is finally in the game: Mouse Support! You can now use a keyboard and mouse to play Circuit Breakers. We're still working on the implementations so expect things to change a little between now and the final release.

There's a good deal of bugs that have been fixed, some of which have been around since the game launched and completely flew under our radar. (And everyone else's too!) Minor gameplay improvements have been made in both Arcade and Wavebuster modes, menus have been tweaked, and optimizations made across the board. HD mode should run fine on all devices, including those with integrated graphics running on systems as old as Windows 7. 

We're not quite done with update 4.0, but today we're lauching a beta branch to help clear out any bugs for the actual launch. To join the beta enter the password "playinhighdef" in Circuit Breakers' Steam properties. Make sure to join our discord as well to give any feedback or suggestions so that we can have a flawless release!

Though this is likely our last Circuit Breakers release, we still make games! Check out some of our new stuff like [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/757160/ULTIMATE_ARENA_SHOWDOWN/]ULTIMATE ARENA: SHOWDOWN[/url] and watch our social media feeds because we're always looking to the future with out projects.

Thanks for Playing!

-Troy

notes.title: Circuit Breakers: 2nd Anniversary
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10623897/b501a8ea624eec47455f08a9244f5cae33b8ff5c.png[/img]

Hey Breakers!

This news was worth the wait! Starting next week we'll be rolling out Circuit Breakers' 2nd Anniversary update on PC, PS4, and XBOX One. Version 3.0 adds 4 new characters to the game, a new gamemode, dozens of new log entries, a new jukebox mode, 3 new powerups, a testing range, 50 new challenges, new music, performance improvements, and many bugfixes. With all this new content we think you'll have a great time picking Circuit Breakers up right where you left it! For our friends on Steam the update will include trading cards for each of the playable characters in the game, we hope you'll have a blast putting together the full set to unlock the cool emotes and backgrounds we've put together for the game. 

Today we'd like to introduce you to Wavebuster, Circuit Breakers' latest gamemode. Wavebuster is a mix between the classic top-down action of Circuit Breakers with a little bit of tower defense. In order to succeed in Wavebuster you'll need to keep the hypercore, and yourself, in one piece for the duration of a few waves. Between waves you'll have the opprotunity to spend cash on walls and turrets to help you defend 6 unique maps that we've put together that we know you'll love. Check out this gameplay video to get a quick glimpse at what you'll be playing next week!

https://youtu.be/zkY4DjisLow

Wavebuster is our final big addition to the game, thanks for being great fans for 2 years! (I can't believe it's been that long!)

Troy Bonneau
President of Triverske

notes.title: Circuit Breakers 2.3.0 - 7 Languages, Performance Improvements, and More!
notes.content:
Hey Breakers,

Sorry for the radio silence, we've been caught up in a couple things since the last release. We hope this update will help you forgive us. Circuit Breakers 2.3.0 is finally here for PC! I'll go over a few of the big additions.

[b]Translation Support[/b]
Circuit Breakers is now fully playable in 7 languages: English, Spanish, French, Italian, German, Dutch, and Japanese. For players in those regions, especially younger ones, we hope this will be a welcome addition to enjoy the game in your native tongue.

[b]Save Fixes[/b]
We noticed that many users were having issues with saving. We've cleared that up and you should be able to save and load without any problems.

[b]Steam Cloud[/b]
Speaking of saves, Circuit Breakers' Steam Cloud support has improved as well. You can now end your game on a Windows PC and pick it up on a Linux PC. Perfect for those who want to keep their save files anywhere they go.

[b]Rebalancing[/b]
Lots of areas that needed attention have finally had their fair share of care and the feel of the game has improved significantly. Lots of tiny adjustments to enemies, rooms, and challenges were made and we know you'll enjoy playing even more now.

[b]Vibration Profiles[/b]
Each character in the game has a different feel for when your controller rumbles. This is an XInput feature only so not everyone will get to try this feature out.

[b]Visual Improvements[/b]
Graphics have been tweaked to make the game look even better than before, specifically in the electric room area. Get to room 21 and see the difference for yourself!

[b]Performance Improvements[/b]
2.3.0 is the leanest, meanest version of Circuit Breakers to date. Even dated computers should be able to run the game with ease. Try Circuit Breakers on a laptop and play with friends anywhere on the go!

[b]Upcoming News[/b]
We're committing to even more updates for Circuit Breakers, follow @Triverske and @ShootAllRobots on Twitter for the latest info. For those out there who haven't ascended, Circuit Breakers released for PS4 this week and wil release soon on XBOX One

-Troy

notes.content:
Hey Breakers,

We have a decent sized update that fixes a lot of the smaller bugs in the game, and adds some polish in some places we thought were lacking. This update was especially needed for our SteamOS and Ubuntu users who have been putting up with our lax dev cycles! 

This update also introduces a new save format and major speedups, so if you've been having trouble running the game go ahead and give it a second chance. 

Currently 1.1.0 is available for Windows and Linux, and will be available to our OSX users later this week.

notes.title: Campaign is Coming.
notes.content:
Hey Breakers,

This is an important annoucement from the Circuit Breakers Development Team @ Triverske. We're proud to announce that we're preparing a multi-part campaign for Circuit Breakers.

Throughout thousands of hours of playtesting we found that Circuit Breakers is most enjoyable when you play with a group of friends in the same room, which can be a problem when you're playing by yourself. Campaign is a mode dedicated to making sure that you can experience the game as it was intended, regardless of how many people you're playing with.

The first episode of the Circuit Breakers Campaign will launch later this month, for free. 

Thank you for your support, expect more news very soon.

-Troy

Circuit Breakers is finally now available on Steam. The team are very excited to see what you think of the game!

We're launching with a 20% discount for the first week and are working very hard on the online multiplayer mode, currently it is in beta and allows connections but it is not recommended to play just yet. More news to come for online multiplayer soon.

For now, try and get a high score in score attack, complete special challenges and let us know who is your favorite character! Personally, I'm a fan of Samson's Missile launcher!

Don't forget to enter the competition to win a full size Arcade Cabinet here: 

http://www.excalibur-publishing.com/pages/circuit-breakers-arcade-cabinet-competition
[img]http://i.imgur.com/f9zS9kA.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Online Multiplayer Beta
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We would like to share details on the multiplayer features of Circuit Breakers.

When the game launches on 17th of November a fully supported local multi-player mode will be available, we’ve tested this for many, many hours and have had great fun shooting robots with friends! Up to four players can play together using 360 controllers and a keyboard.

We do have online multi-player working, however we understand that it needs just a little bit of attention before it becomes a fully-fledged online mode.  Therefore the online portion will be currently named as “online beta”. Over the next few weeks we’d greatly appreciate any input or reporting any issues to us regarding the online beta.

Feel free report any issues to us at support@excalibur-publishing.com and we can begin eliminating them up to the final launch of Online Multi-player.

notes.title: Update Notes | RC 1.1.0
notes.content:
Hello again,

We have a slightly larger update today that fixes some slightly larger bugs as well as several minor bugs.

Changes since 1.0.2
[list]
    [*]Fixed an issue where enemies would stop spawning and would prevent futher progressing
    [*]Added text to certain menus for clarification purposes
    [*]Fixed an issue where all Score Attack courses were unlocked from the start
    [*]Fixed an issue that would allow players to choose locked characters
    [*]Fixed an issue where unlocking cores did not work correctly
    [*]Fixed an issue where only BAX would appear in Arcade mode boss rooms
    [*]Fixed an issue where stats could be seen for locked characters
    [*]Fixed an issue where elite drums would not explode
    [*]Fixed a few logbook entries
[/list]

I happened to get my Steam controller yesterday. It works fine with the game but I haven't really found the perfect preset yet. 

If you don't see "RC 1.1.0" on your main menu then you aren't up to date. If you don't see the update available on Steam try restarting.

notes.title: Win A Custom Designed Circuit Breakers Arcade Machine
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/6QaCwZ9.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone! 

Circuit Breakers is just under a week away from launch as the game unlocks on November 17th 2015. Triverske have been working very hard on getting the game up to final release and we can not wait for you all to get your hands on the game.

To celebrate the launch of Circuit Breakers we are running a special competition where players can win a custom designed Arcade Machine. This is being manufactured by professional Arcade Machine experts and is custom built to run Circuit Breakers.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/sYt4EYO.png[/img]

The machine will have Steam installed and will not be limited to only run Circuit Breakers. The machine will also feature USB ports to plug in additional controllers so up to four friends can play Circuit Breakers together.

To enter this competition just click the link below to be taken to a competition site to register your details

 [url=http://www.excalibur-publishing.com/pages/circuit-breakers-arcade-cabinet-competition]Click here to enter the competition[/url]

More detailed specs on the Arcade machine including final design and the system specs to be announced soon.

Circuit Breakers releases on November 17th at $9.99/€9.99/£6.99 with a 20% off that price in the first week.
